title: Remembering Is Not Enough: Refining Memories and Learning When to Use Them in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.36652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory helps LLM-based multi-agent systems reuse experience, but stored advice can be flawed or applied in the wrong situation. Team-level success or failure alone cannot reliably show whether a memory needs correction or should not have been used. We propose DiscernMem, a training-free framework that improves both memory quality and memory use. To improve quality, Defect-Aware Memory Refinement (DMR) compares team executions with a single memory and with no memory, diagnoses rule defects, and tests repairs on current and earlier tasks to guard against losing previously useful behavior. To guide appropriate use, Boundary-Learning Meta-Memory (BLM) records each memory's past uses and effects, learning when its owner role should apply or avoid it based on task context and incoming messages. Together, these components help teams correct flawed experience while retaining useful rules that were applied incorrectly. Experiments with Qwen3-4B-I

translated_title: 记忆还不够：在多智能体系统中精炼记忆并学习何时使用记忆
translated_abstract: 记忆可以帮助基于大语言模型的多智能体系统复用经验，但存储的建议可能存在缺陷，或者在不恰当的情境中被使用。仅凭团队层面的成功或失败，无法可靠地判断某条记忆是否需要修正，或是否本不应被使用。我们提出了DiscernMem，这是一个无需训练的框架，能够同时提升记忆质量与记忆使用。为提升记忆质量，缺陷感知记忆精炼（DMR）将使用单条记忆与不使用记忆的团队执行结果进行对比，诊断规则缺陷，并在当前及以往任务上测试修复效果，以避免丢失先前有用的行为。为引导恰当使用，边界学习元记忆（BLM）记录每条记忆的过往使用情况及其效果，学习其所属角色在何种任务情境和接收消息下应当应用或避免使用该记忆。这些组件共同帮助团队纠正有缺陷的经验，同时保留那些被错误使用的有用规则。基于Qwen3-4B-I的实验（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出无需训练的DiscernMem框架，通过缺陷感知记忆精炼（DMR）诊断并修复有缺陷的记忆，通过边界学习元记忆（BLM）学习在何种情境下应使用或避免使用记忆，从而同时提升多智能体系统的记忆质量与记忆使用效果。
en_tdlr: DiscernMem is a training-free framework that improves both memory quality and memory use in LLM-based multi-agent systems by refining defective memories via Defect-Aware Memory Refinement and learning when to apply or avoid each memory via Boundary-Learning Meta-Memory.
